# FreshAuthority

> FreshAuthority sells daily FMCSA new-authority lead files by subscription to trucking insurance agents and factoring companies. Every new FMCSA operating authority granted in a subscriber's state is delivered as a clean CSV by 6 AM ET, with the carrier's current insurer and policy timing first, then phone, email, fleet size, and cargo. Every plan also includes two trigger files: carriers whose liability insurance renews in the next 60 days, and carriers whose liability filing recently lapsed. Operated by MS ECOM LLC. Business phone: (586) 203-9434. Contact: mitchell@msecomllc.com.

## Who it is for

- Trucking insurance agents who write new motor carriers and need the FMCSA new authority list daily, before competitors see it.
- Freight factoring companies that need new carrier leads — companies with a brand-new authority and, in most cases, no factor yet.
- Also used by trucking dispatch services and compliance services prospecting newly granted carriers.

## Pricing (USD, per month)

- All States: $49/mo — all 50 states' daily new-authority files and trigger files (renewals due in 60 days and lapsed liability included), plus a book watchlist of up to 500 of the subscriber's own carriers.
- Plus Feeds: $99/mo — everything in All States, plus the revocations + reinstatements feed, the insurance filing + cancellation feed, the phone/address/name change feed, dialer-ready files, and a 5,000-carrier watchlist with full change feeds.
- There is no one-state tier; every plan covers all 50 states.
- Annual billing is available on the same plans at two months free ($490/yr, $990/yr).

## Trial, sample, and guarantee

- Free 25-lead sample: a free sample of 25 leads from any one state, no card required.
- Free 7-day trial: every paid plan starts with a free 7-day trial; no card is needed to start and there is no charge for the first 7 days — the card is added when the paid plan begins on day 7. If a subscriber asks within 7 days of the first paid charge, that charge is refunded in full.
- Accuracy guarantee: if fewer than 95% of rows in a file have a working phone or email, that month is free.
- Delivery: files are delivered by 6 AM ET on delivery mornings.
- Data source: public records published by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) and the U.S. Department of Transportation. FreshAuthority is not affiliated with FMCSA or USDOT.
